events.title: Releasing 25 November for $6.99
events.summary: Grimsly has finally set a release date and price: Snackrifice will go live on 25th November 2026 and you'll be able to grab a copy for $6.99.A huge thank you again to everyone that has tried the demo and given feedback. We have a ton of ideas post launch and we cannot wait to share them with you!-Karnage Studios

events.title: Major Demo Update
events.summary: The Master has cooked up a massive update to the demo!General ChangesNew curses.New status effects:BleedingBurningPoisonNew enemy - Dragon Whelp.A ton of new character cosmetic options.Special rooms now appear in Purgatory to help you - Make sure you explore!New end of round stats with a brand new UI.Many many many other small refinements.You can now reset and continue after a failed run without going back to the main menu - Sorry about that :')Bug FixesI would love to list all the bugs we fixed

events.title: Demo Update 0.1.3458
